oneRun.title: One salary, start to finish.
oneRun.s1Text: Upload a spreadsheet of who gets what. Kalypso checks every address and amount, then asks you to approve the whole run once.
oneRun.s2Text: The amount is encrypted on your machine, and a zero-knowledge proof shows it is a valid payment your treasury can afford, without showing the number.
oneRun.s3Heading: The ledger records that it happened.
oneRun.s3Text: Stellar stores the payment and marks the worker paid for this run. The amount stays sealed for everyone who looks.
oneRun.s4Heading: The worker opens their own line.
oneRun.s4Text: Each worker holds a key that opens their pay and nothing else. Sign in with Face ID or a wallet, read the payslip, cash out.
oneRun.s5Text: Your accountant's key opens every amount the company paid, so audits, payroll tax and year-end still work. Nobody else ever can.

threeKeys.title: Three people. Three keys.
threeKeys.lead: Each key opens exactly what its holder should see, and the chain enforces it, not a server.
threeKeys.employerText: Uploads a spreadsheet, approves the run once, and pays everyone in USDC from a treasury that only their own signature can move. Kalypso pays at most once per worker per run, enforced by the contract.
threeKeys.workerText: Joins with an invite, holds a key only they control, and reads their own payslips. Nobody else on the payroll, and nobody on the internet, can see what they earn.
threeKeys.accountantText: Registers their own key and gives the company its id. That key opens every amount the company paid and nothing a worker received from anyone else.

checkUs.title: Check it yourself.
checkUs.lead: Everything Kalypso claims can be checked from a terminal against the live testnet contracts.
checkUs.c1Text: The verifier that checks every proof has no admin left, and neither of our contracts has an admin or an upgrade path. The check reads it from the chain.
checkUs.c2Heading: The code on chain is this code.
checkUs.c2Text: GitHub builds each release and signs a build attestation. The payroll contract running on testnet traces back to release v{version} of the public repository.
checkUs.c3Text: One command attacks the live showcase company the ways the threat model names, and prints what stopped each attack.

footer.tagline: Payroll on Stellar where nobody can read the salaries except the people who should.
footer.label: Footer
footer.note: Stellar testnet only. Not audited by a security firm. Built for the Find Your Way hackathon.

intro.title: Run a real payroll in three minutes.
intro.lead: Your browser creates a company, its accountant and three workers on Stellar testnet, funds them with test money, and pays the team through Kalypso with real zero-knowledge proofs. No wallet, no sign-up. Then you open the payroll as each of them.
intro.promise1: Every step is a real testnet transaction you can open on stellar.expert.
intro.promise2: The keys live only in this browser. Close the tab and come back to resume.
intro.promise3: Free test XLM comes from Stellar's friendbot; nothing here costs real money.

errors.unknown: Something unexpected stopped this step. Check your connection and try again; Kalypso carries on from what is on chain.

console.NOT_TESTNET: This build of Kalypso is not set up for Stellar testnet, so nothing was sent.
console.STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE: This browser does not let Kalypso keep the treasury records it needs (private browsing can block it), so nothing was sent.
console.STORAGE_FAILED: This browser refused to save or read a treasury record, so nothing was sent. Leave private browsing or free some disk space, then try again.
console.BUSY: Another Kalypso tab is working with this wallet right now. Finish there, then try again.
console.ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND: This wallet's account does not exist on testnet yet. Fund it with test XLM from friendbot (Freighter's Fund button does this), then try again.
console.KEY_NOT_DERIVED: The wallet's signatures could not make a Kalypso key, so nothing was sent.
console.ACCOUNTANT_ID_INVALID: The accountant id must be a whole number, exactly as the accountant's own screen shows it.
console.ACCOUNTANT_ADDRESS_INVALID: The accountant's address is not a valid Stellar address.
console.ACCOUNTANT_UNKNOWN: No accountant key is registered under this id. Ask your accountant for the id their own screen shows.
console.ACCOUNTANT_MISMATCH: This accountant id belongs to a different address from the one entered. Check both with your accountant before going on.
console.ACCOUNTANT_KEY_INVALID: The accountant key to confirm is missing or damaged. Check the accountant id again first.
console.ACCOUNTANT_KEY_CHANGED: The key under this accountant id changed since it was checked. Check it with your accountant again before going on.
console.ACCOUNTANT_ID_NOT_YOURS: This id is not registered to this wallet with the key it makes here, so it was not used. Register your key to get your own id.
console.DEMO_ACCOUNTANT: This accountant id is Kalypso's public demo key: anyone can read payroll under it. Ask your accountant to register their own key and use that id.
console.BOOKS_NOT_YOURS: This company's books are sealed to an accountant id this wallet's key does not hold, so they cannot be opened with it.
console.BOOKS_INCOMPLETE: The books are incomplete, so nothing was exported. Try again in a minute.
console.LABEL_INVALID: The company name must be 1 to 64 bytes long.
console.COMPANY_ID_INVALID: The company id must be a whole number.
console.COMPANY_NOT_FOUND: No company exists under this id on the payroll contract.
console.COMPANY_MISMATCH: The company under this id was set up with a different admin, accountant or name, so nothing was changed.
console.NOT_ADMIN: This wallet is not the company's admin, so it cannot act for the company.
console.TREASURY_BOUND_ELSEWHERE: This wallet is already registered with the confidential token under another accountant id, and that can never change. Use a fresh wallet for a company with this accountant.
console.TREASURY_KEYS_MISMATCH: This wallet is registered with the confidential token under keys Kalypso did not make here, so nothing was changed.
console.TREASURY_NOT_REGISTERED: Set up the company first: this wallet is not registered with the confidential token yet.
console.AMOUNT_INVALID: The deposit must be above zero and no more than the token can hold.
console.USDC_SHORT: This wallet holds less testnet USDC than this deposit. Get testnet USDC from the Stellar Laboratory (lab.stellar.org) or swap test XLM for USDC on the testnet DEX, then try again.
console.WORKERS_INVALID: The worker list is empty, too long, or has an address that cannot be invited.
console.PERIOD_INVALID: Pick a month from 1 to 12 and a four-digit year.
console.CSV_INVALID: The payroll file has problems, so nothing was sent. Fix the lines listed and upload it again.
console.RUN_MISMATCH: This month's run is already open for a different number of payments. Pay it with the same file, or pick another month.
console.RUN_CLOSED: This month's run is closed and takes no more payments. Pick another month.
console.NOT_ENOUGH_WORKERS: The file lists more workers than have joined the company. Each worker must accept their invite first.
console.RUN_REFUSED: The payroll run was refused before anything was sent.
console.NEEDS_REBUILD: This device's treasury records do not match the chain. Rebuild the treasury from the chain, check the result, then pay again.
console.PAYMENT_PENDING: A payment from this treasury is still settling on the network. Try again in a few minutes.
console.RECORD_DAMAGED: This browser's record of the payment in flight is damaged, so nothing was sent.
console.RECORD_NOT_DAMAGED: This browser's record of the payment in flight reads fine, so it was not cleared. Run the payroll again to settle it.
console.DEPOSIT_PENDING: A deposit is still waiting on the network. Try again in a minute.
console.AMOUNT_MISMATCH: A payment did not move exactly the approved amount, so the run stopped.
console.PAID_ELSEWHERE: Some rows were paid by another tab or device. Nobody was paid twice. Reload the run.
console.HISTORY_INCOMPLETE: The treasury's history could not be read in full, so nothing was saved. Try again later.
console.SIMULATION_FAILED: The network would not run this call, so nothing was signed.
console.FEE_TOO_HIGH: The network asked for a fee above Kalypso's cap for this call, so nothing was signed.
console.SUBMIT_REFUSED: The network refused the transaction, so nothing changed. Try again.
console.TRANSACTION_FAILED: The transaction failed on chain, so nothing changed. Try again.
console.TRANSACTION_EXPIRED: The transaction expired before it landed, so nothing changed. Try again.
console.TRANSACTION_PENDING: A transaction is still waiting on the network. Try again in a minute and Kalypso carries on from the chain.
console.WALLET_CHANGED_TRANSACTION: The wallet returned a different transaction from the one it was asked to sign. Nothing was sent.
console.NOT_ON_CHAIN: The transaction landed, but the chain does not show its result yet. Try again in a minute.
console.CHAIN_DISAGREES: The chain answered in a way Kalypso does not expect, so it stopped before sending anything more.

worker.INVALID_INPUT: Kalypso was given settings it cannot use. Reload the page and try again.
worker.NO_SESSION: You are signed out. Sign in again to continue.
worker.BUSY: This is already running in another tab. Finish it there, or close that tab and try again.
worker.NETWORK: Kalypso could not reach the Stellar test network. Check your connection and try again.
worker.STORAGE_FAILED: That worked, but this browser would not let Kalypso remember it. Allow site storage and try again.
worker.UNEXPECTED: Something went wrong. Try again, and Kalypso picks up from what the chain already shows.
worker.PASSKEY_UNSUPPORTED: This browser cannot use passkeys. Use a current browser, or sign in with Freighter.
worker.PASSKEY_CANCELLED: The passkey prompt was closed before it finished. Try again when you are ready.
worker.PASSKEY_WRONG_SITE: This page is not allowed to use passkeys for Kalypso. Open Kalypso from its own address.
worker.PASSKEY_FAILED: The passkey did not answer the way Kalypso needs. Try again.
worker.NO_USER_VERIFICATION: The passkey did not confirm it was you (Face ID, fingerprint or PIN). Kalypso needs that check every time.
worker.PRF_UNAVAILABLE: This passkey cannot create a Kalypso private key. Use a passkey provider that supports PRF, or sign in with Freighter.
worker.WALLET_SETUP_FAILED: Kalypso could not prepare your new wallet. Check your connection and try again.
worker.WALLET_RECORD_INVALID: This browser's record of your new wallet is damaged, so it cannot be set up. Create a new account.
worker.WALLET_CODE_UNKNOWN: The wallet at this address runs code Kalypso does not trust, so it will not be used.
worker.PASSKEY_NOT_THIS_WALLET: This passkey is not the one that controls this wallet.
worker.PASSKEY_WALLET_UNKNOWN: Kalypso cannot find the wallet for this passkey. If you made it on another device, finish joining there first.
worker.ADDRESS_TAKEN: This address was taken before your wallet was set up. Create a new pay key.
worker.WALLET_BIRTH_UNKNOWN: Kalypso could not confirm how this wallet was set up just now, so its address stays hidden for now. Your payslips and cash-out still work below. Try again in a minute.
worker.WALLET_ADDRESS_INVALID: The wallet did not give a Stellar account address.
worker.WALLET_REJECTED: The wallet did not approve the request.
worker.WALLET_NOT_REPRODUCIBLE: This wallet gave two different signatures for the same message, so it cannot rebuild your key next time. Use a wallet that signs the same way each time, such as Freighter.
worker.WALLET_SIGNATURE_INVALID: The wallet's signature is not this account's signature over the Kalypso key message. Sign it again.
worker.WALLET_ACCOUNT_MISSING: This wallet account is not on the Stellar test network yet. Fund it with friendbot, then try again.
worker.WALLET_CHANGED_TRANSACTION: The wallet returned a different transaction from the one it was asked to sign, so nothing was sent.
worker.SIGNING_TOO_SLOW: The approval took longer than the minute the relayer accepts. Try again and approve a little sooner.
worker.KEYS_MISMATCH: This account is registered with other private keys than the ones this sign-in made, so its pay cannot be read here.
worker.COMPANY_NOT_FOUND: There is no company with that id.
worker.NOT_INVITED: This company has not invited this account. Ask them to invite the address shown here.
worker.INVITE_WITHDRAWN: This invite was withdrawn, or you were removed from the company. Ask them to invite you again.
worker.NOT_REGISTERED: This account is not set up for private pay yet. Join a company first.
worker.AUDITOR_ID_TAKEN: The audit key id does not belong to you, so Kalypso will not register under it.
worker.PROOF_REFUSED: The network refused this browser's proof, so nothing changed. Try again.
worker.SIMULATION_FAILED: The network would not run this step, so nothing was sent.
worker.FEE_TOO_HIGH: The network asked for a fee above Kalypso's cap, so nothing was signed.
worker.TX_FAILED: The transaction reached the network but failed there, so nothing changed. Try again.
worker.TX_PENDING: The transaction has not landed yet. Check again in a minute; Kalypso will not send it twice.
worker.CHAIN_DISAGREES: The chain does not show what this step should have done. Try again in a minute.
worker.HISTORY_INCOMPLETE: History incomplete: the balance this browser rebuilt does not match the chain yet, so nothing was withdrawn. Try again shortly.
worker.INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS: That is more than your private balance holds.
worker.NOTHING_TO_MERGE: There is no incoming pay waiting to be moved into your balance.
worker.AMOUNT_MISMATCH: The withdrawal proof did not move exactly the amount asked for, so nothing was sent.
worker.WITHDRAW_NOT_CONFIRMED: The network took the move, but your balance did not change as expected, so Kalypso cannot confirm it. Check your payslips in a minute before you try again.
worker.CASHOUT_SETUP_FAILED: Kalypso could not set up your cash-out account on the test network. Try again in a minute.
worker.ANCHOR_UNAVAILABLE: The cash-out service could not be reached. Try again shortly.
worker.ANCHOR_CONFIG_INVALID: The cash-out service published settings Kalypso does not accept, so nothing was signed.
worker.ANCHOR_CHALLENGE_INVALID: The cash-out service sent a sign-in request Kalypso does not accept, so nothing was signed.
worker.ANCHOR_REFUSED: The cash-out service refused the request.
worker.ANCHOR_NOT_READY: The cash-out service is still waiting for you to finish its page.
worker.ANCHOR_RECORD_INVALID: The cash-out service's record of this withdrawal is not one Kalypso can pay, so nothing was built.
worker.ANCHOR_RECORD_CHANGED: The cash-out service changed its request after you saw it, so nothing was sent. Start the cash-out again.
worker.CASHOUT_NO_XLM: Your cash-out account has no XLM left for the network fee, so nothing was sent. Fund it with friendbot, then try again.
worker.ANCHOR_ALREADY_PAID: This cash-out was already paid from your account, so it was not sent again.

sponsor.checkFirst: It may still reach the network, so Kalypso checks the chain before trying again.
sponsor.bad_shape: The fee sponsor does not pay for a transaction shaped like this one.
sponsor.bad_encoding: The transaction was not encoded the way the fee sponsor requires.
sponsor.envelope_not_accepted: The fee sponsor only pays for a plain signed transaction.
sponsor.not_one_operation: The fee sponsor only pays for a transaction that does exactly one thing.
sponsor.not_invoke_host_function: The fee sponsor only pays for calls into Kalypso's contracts.
sponsor.missing_soroban_data: The transaction does not state its resource limits, so the fee sponsor will not pay for it.
sponsor.wasm_upload: The fee sponsor never pays to upload contract code.
sponsor.contract_creation: The fee sponsor only pays to create a passkey wallet set up the way Kalypso sets one up.
sponsor.root_contract_not_allowed: The fee sponsor only pays for calls into the Kalypso payroll and token contracts, and for registering your own audit key.
sponsor.nested_contract_not_allowed: This call reaches a contract the fee sponsor does not pay for.
sponsor.no_auth: The call carries no approval from you, so the fee sponsor will not pay for it.
sponsor.source_account_auth: The fee sponsor needs your own approval on this call, not the sender's.
sponsor.too_many_auth_entries: The call asks for more approvals than the fee sponsor accepts.
sponsor.auth_tree_too_large: The call asks for more permissions than the fee sponsor accepts.
sponsor.unsigned_auth: An approval this call needs has not been signed.
sponsor.signer_key_mismatch: An approval was signed by a different key than the account it speaks for.
sponsor.not_signed_for_testnet: The approval was not signed for the Stellar test network.
sponsor.fee_over_cap: This transaction costs more than the fee sponsor pays for one action.
sponsor.auth_expired: Your approval ran out before the fee sponsor could send it. Approve it again.
sponsor.auth_expiry_too_far: Your approval stays valid longer than the fee sponsor accepts. Approve it again.
sponsor.simulation_failed: The network would not run this transaction, so nothing was sent.
sponsor.simulation_needs_restore: Some contract data this needs is archived and has to be restored before it can run.
sponsor.read_only_call: This call changes nothing, so the fee sponsor will not pay for it.
sponsor.unused_auth: The transaction carries an approval the call does not use, so the fee sponsor refused it.
sponsor.unknown_wallet_code: Your wallet runs code the fee sponsor does not trust, so it will not pay for it.
sponsor.foreign_contract_in_footprint: This call touches a contract the fee sponsor does not pay for.
sponsor.footprint_not_declared: The transaction does not list everything it touches, so it would fail on the network.
sponsor.resources_not_declared: The transaction reserves less work than it needs, so it would fail on the network.
sponsor.rpc_unavailable: The fee sponsor could not reach the Stellar network. Try again shortly.
sponsor.method_not_allowed: The fee sponsor was called the wrong way. Reload the page and try again.
sponsor.no_client_ip: The fee sponsor could not tell where the request came from, so it refused it. Try again on a normal connection.
sponsor.rate_limited: This connection has used its free requests for now: a few an hour, and a few new Face ID wallets a day. Try again later, or from another network.
sponsor.unsupported_media_type: The fee sponsor was sent a request it does not read. Reload the page and try again.
sponsor.body_too_large: This transaction is too large for the fee sponsor.
sponsor.invalid_json: The fee sponsor could not read the request. Reload the page and try again.
sponsor.duplicate_in_flight: This exact transaction is already being sent. Wait for it to finish.
sponsor.auth_entry_in_use: This approval is already being used by another request. Wait for it to finish.
sponsor.address_rate_limited: This account has used up its sponsored transactions for today. Try again tomorrow.
sponsor.daily_budget_spent: The fee sponsor has spent today's budget. Try again tomorrow.
sponsor.relay_timeout: The relayer did not answer in time. {checkFirst}
sponsor.relay_unavailable: The relayer could not be reached. {checkFirst}
sponsor.relay_bad_reply: The relayer gave an answer the fee sponsor could not read. {checkFirst}
sponsor.internal_error: The fee sponsor had an internal error. {checkFirst}
sponsor.not_configured: The fee sponsor is not set up on this site yet.
sponsor.bad_id: The fee sponsor did not recognise that transaction.
sponsor.bad_request: Kalypso asked about a wallet setup in a form the server does not read. Reload the page and try again.
sponsor.bad_address: That is not a wallet address the server recognises.
sponsor.bad_hash: That is not a transaction hash the server recognises.
sponsor.birth_unavailable: The network does not show that wallet setup yet. Try again in a minute.
sponsor.not_a_birth: That transaction did not create this wallet, so it was not recorded.
sponsor.creation_not_recorded: The fee sponsor could not note this wallet setup before sending it, so nothing was sent. Try again in a minute.
sponsor.network: Kalypso could not reach the fee sponsor. {checkFirst}
sponsor.timeout: The fee sponsor did not answer in time. {checkFirst}
sponsor.bad_reply: The fee sponsor gave an answer Kalypso could not read. {checkFirst}
sponsor.unknown_refusal: The fee sponsor refused for a reason Kalypso does not know. {checkFirst}
sponsor.relay_failed: The relayer could not send this transaction, so nothing reached the network. Try again.
sponsor.still_pending: The fee sponsor has not finished sending this transaction yet. Check again in a minute.

wallet.NOT_INSTALLED: Freighter is not installed, or it is locked. Install it from freighter.app or open it and enter your password, then try again.
wallet.ACCESS_REFUSED: Freighter did not share an account with Kalypso. Approve the connection in Freighter, then try again.
wallet.WRONG_NETWORK: Switch Freighter to Testnet, then try again.
wallet.NETWORK_UNREADABLE: Kalypso could not read which network Freighter is on, so nothing was signed. Open Freighter and enter your password, then try again.
wallet.SIGN_REFUSED: Freighter did not sign, so nothing was sent.
wallet.WRONG_SIGNER: Freighter signed with a different account from the one connected. Switch Freighter back to that account, then try again.
wallet.BAD_SIGNATURE: Freighter returned a signature that does not check out for this account and message, so it was not used.
wallet.CHANGED_TRANSACTION: Freighter returned a different transaction from the one it was asked to sign, or one this account did not sign. Nothing was sent.

sandbox.INVALID_AMOUNTS: These salaries are larger than the token can hold.
sandbox.NOT_ENOUGH_XLM: Friendbot did not give enough test XLM to run the sandbox. Try again in a minute.
sandbox.BUSY: Another tab is running this sandbox. Finish there, or close that tab and try again.
sandbox.NO_SANDBOX: This browser has no saved sandbox to pick up. Start a new one.
sandbox.SIMULATION_FAILED: The network would not run this step, so nothing was sent.
sandbox.FEE_TOO_HIGH: The network asked for a fee above the sandbox's cap, so nothing was signed.
sandbox.SUBMIT_REFUSED: The network refused the transaction. Try again: the sandbox carries on from the chain.
sandbox.TRANSACTION_FAILED: The transaction failed on chain. Try again: the sandbox carries on from the chain.
sandbox.TRANSACTION_EXPIRED: The transaction expired before it landed. Try again: the sandbox carries on from the chain.
sandbox.PENDING: A transaction is still waiting on the network. Try again in a minute.
sandbox.NOT_ON_CHAIN: The transaction landed, but the chain does not show its result yet. Try again in a minute.
sandbox.CHAIN_DISAGREES: The chain answered in a way the sandbox does not expect, so it stopped.
sandbox.PAY_FAILED: A payment did not go through, so the sandbox stopped before the next one. Try again.

csv.FILE_TOO_LARGE: {where} is larger than {kb} KB. Split it into smaller files.
csv.TOO_MANY_ROWS: {where} has more than {rows} payroll rows. Split it into smaller files.
csv.NO_ROWS: {where} has no payroll rows. Each row needs a worker's address and an amount.
csv.UNCLOSED_QUOTE: {where} opens a quote mark that is never closed, so the rest of the file cannot be read safely.
csv.LINE_ENDINGS: {where} uses a line break the importer does not accept. Save the file again as "CSV UTF-8".
csv.QUOTE: {where} has a quote mark in the wrong place. A quoted cell must start and end with a quote, with "" for a quote inside it.
csv.EXTRA_COLUMN: {where} has more than 3 cells. Use address, amount and an optional name, with any comma inside a name in quotes.
csv.MISSING_COLUMN: {where} needs an address and an amount, separated by a comma (not a semicolon).
csv.AMOUNT_SPLIT: {where} has a name that is only a number, which usually means a comma split the amount. Write the amount without commas.
csv.NAME_TOO_LONG: {where} has a name longer than {chars} characters.
csv.NAME_INVALID: {where} has a name with a control character, such as a tab or a line break.
csv.ADDRESS_MUXED_NOT_ALLOWED: {where} has a muxed address (starting with M). Use the worker's plain G address.
csv.ADDRESS_LOOKS_LIKE_SECRET: {where} has what looks like a secret key (starting with S) instead of an address. Delete it from the file and never share it.
csv.ADDRESS_INVALID: {where} has an address that is not a valid Stellar address. Check it for typos.
csv.AMOUNT_NOT_A_NUMBER: {where} has an amount that is not a plain number. Use digits with an optional dot, like 1250.50.
csv.AMOUNT_NEGATIVE: {where} has a negative amount. Pay amounts must be above zero.
csv.AMOUNT_ZERO: {where} has an amount of zero. Pay amounts must be above zero.
csv.AMOUNT_TOO_MANY_DECIMALS: {where} has an amount with more than 7 decimal places. USDC stops at 0.0000001.
csv.AMOUNT_EXPONENT: {where} has an amount in scientific notation, like 1e3. Write the full number.
csv.AMOUNT_SEPARATOR: {where} has an amount with a thousands separator or a comma. Write 1000.50, not 1,000.50.
csv.AMOUNT_TOO_LARGE: {where} has an amount larger than the token can hold.
csv.DUPLICATE: {where} repeats the address on line {first}. List each worker once, with their total for the run.
csv.DUPLICATE_UNKNOWN: {where} repeats the address on an earlier line. List each worker once, with their total for the run.
csv.OTHER: {where}: a problem the importer did not name.

run.failed: This payment did not go through.
